An attacker can upload an SVG (`image/svg+xml` passes the filter) which is later served via GET /data/recipes_pics/:filename with `Content-Type: image/svg+xml` — an actively-executable content type (script-capable, XSS-equivalent to serving attacker HTML) — inferred straight from the attacker-chosen file extension with no re-validation of actual content. No existing filed entry or found_bugs.jsonl entry covers this content-type/upload-trust root cause. Not a duplicate.
</dup_check>
